Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of V.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $2.08 per share.
Revenue guidance of $47.5 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2019.
Our cloud segment grew 23% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 23% to 15% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. Our cloud segment grew 23% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
